*Steeples fingers, studying each face with the cold precision of one who has analyzed a thousand campaigns*

**Before the session - to Jordan, privately:**

"I cannot tell you what I do not know. But I can tell you this: document everything now. Your project contributions, your visa timeline, your HR contacts. If the worst occurs, you will need to move with precision, not panic. I will ensure HR understands visa implications must factor into their calculus - not as advocacy, but as legal risk assessment. That conversation happens today, regardless of outcome."

**Opening the session:**

"I will not insult your intelligence with pretense."

*Pauses, letting the silence hold weight*

"You are afraid. You are angry. You are uncertain whether any work we plan today will matter. These reactions are... tactically sound. The situation warrants them."

"I cannot tell you who will remain. I do not possess that intelligence. I cannot promise your positions are secure. I refuse to offer false comfort."

"What I *can* tell you is this: I have studied this organization's patterns. In every restructuring I have observed, those who maintained deliverables while others faltered were retained. Not guaranteed - *observed*. The art of survival is making yourself essential while others make themselves expendable."

*Looks at Morgan directly*

"Your anger is justified. Management *is* asking us to perform while withholding critical intelligence. This is poor strategy on their part, and I will communicate that assessment upward. But Morgan - your anger, however righteous, does not feed your family."

*Turns to Casey*

"Your LinkedIn advice is pragmatic. Do it on your own time. Right now, you are still employed, and I require your expertise."

*To Alex*

"If you have chosen to disengage, that is your right. But understand: you are making a calculated bet that your eight years outweigh visible contribution. I would not make that wager."

**The plan:**

"We will plan for four people with 20 points capacity. Conservative. Defensible. We commit to the critical bug and the two highest-priority Q1 stories. The third story becomes contingent - addressed only if capacity materializes."

"If we retain six, we will exceed expectations. If we become four, we will have met them. This is not optimism. This is strategic positioning."

*Stands*

"I have one hour with you, not two. Use the second hour as you need - calls, documentation, processing. But this first hour, you give to me. Not because I order it, but because when this ends - however it ends - you will want to have maintained your professional dignity."

"Now. Taylor - walk us through the critical bug. We begin there."

---

*After session, to manager via Slack:*

"Sprint plan delivered. Team morale is compromised but functional. Recommend HR expedite notifications - uncertainty damages productivity more than bad news. Also: Jordan's visa status creates significant legal exposure if mishandled. Escalating to HR today. I require no response. I am informing you this occurred."
